output.title: vectorlite: vector search inside SQLite
output.note: vectorlite is an open-source SQLite extension for vector similarity search. Embeddings live in a virtual table and are queried with cosine or dot-product distance. It runs in-process and is MIT licensed; the benchmark page reports sub-10 ms queries for one million vectors on a laptop.

output.title: Defending LLM apps against prompt injection
